         AMMONIUM PICRICUM

       Pictrate of Ammonia

      (AMMONIUM PICRATUM)


A remedy for malarial fever and neuralgias and so-called, bilious
      headaches. Pain in occiput and mastoid region. Whooping cough.



Head.--  Periodical neuralgia   in right
      side of occiput  ; boring extends to ear, orbit, and jaw. Vertigo on rising. Periodic
      bilious headaches (  Sanguin  ).



Dose.--  Third trituration.
